transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I’ve just been feeling… cloudy in my head. At work, I’ll look at a board packet or a vendor email and I can’t seem to make even simple decisions like I used to. It’s been bothering me.
How long have you been feeling this way, and have you noticed any other changes in your mood or energy level during this time?
Maybe about two weeks now. It kind of started after my husband retired and was home all day. My energy and confidence felt… different at first, and then this low, cloudy feeling settled in.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess I have. I haven’t really wanted to go to my dance class, or stop in at the little galleries like I usually do. Even cooking Sunday food for my family feels like too much, and that’s usually something that makes me feel like myself.
Have you stopped getting pleasure or enjoyment from activities that you used to like, such as your dance class or visiting galleries?

Yes… I guess I have. I just haven’t felt like going to dance class, or looking at the little galleries. Even cooking Sunday food for my family… I don’t really feel up to it, and that’s usually something I enjoy.
Has doing things you used to find enjoyable, like your dance class or visiting galleries, felt completely unrewarding or without any pleasure?

Yeah… pretty much. I just don’t really want to go to dance, or look at the galleries. Even making Sunday food for my family feels kind of empty, and that’s usually something that makes me feel like me.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy, or do you feel more tired than usual even when you haven't done much?
I don’t know… not really a big drop, I guess. I get tired, but I haven’t noticed anything too different that way.
Have you found that you take no pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, most days?

Most days, yeah… I just haven’t wanted to do those things. Dance class, the little galleries… even cooking Sunday food for my family. Those usually feel like me, but lately I just don’t have much interest.
Have you felt a noticeable loss of energy or felt fatigued most days, even when you haven’t been doing much?
Not most days, no. I mean, I get tired sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed a big loss of energy like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?
A little, yeah. I don’t eat much during the day… mostly coffee and a few bites of something. Then at night I’ll pick at tortillas or something sweet, but I’m not really enjoying it.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, like trouble falling asleep, waking up a lot during the night, or sleeping much more than usual?
I don’t know… I haven’t really kept track. Some nights are better than others, but I can’t say I’ve noticed a big change.
Would you say that most days you feel a noticeable loss of energy or feel fatigued, even when you haven't been doing much?
No, I don’t think so. I get tired here and there, but not most days like that.
Have you felt like a failure or blamed yourself for things more than usual lately?

Yeah… a little. I keep thinking I shouldn’t have said so much to the residents, like promising things before I really checked the money. Nobody’s told me I ruined anything, but I still feel like I let them down.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety more than usual?
A little, I guess. At home I feel kind of slow, like my legs are heavy. But in meetings I notice I’m tapping my pen or shifting around… like I’m too keyed up to just sit still.
Do you find yourself feeling like a failure or blaming yourself for things almost every day?

Almost every day? I don’t know if I’d say that. But it comes up a lot… I keep thinking I talked too big to the residents, promised things before I checked the money. Nobody’s said I messed everything up, but I still feel bad about it.
Would you say that your low or depressed mood has been present most days, nearly every day, for at least the past two weeks?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been about two weeks, maybe since my husband retired and was suddenly home all day. The cloudy feeling has been there most days.
Would you say that most days you feel a noticeable loss of energy or feel fatigued, even when you haven't been doing much?
I’m not sure. I mean, I get tired sometimes, but I haven’t really been keeping track of it. It’s not something I’ve noticed every day, exactly.
Have you found it harder to think clearly or concentrate on tasks lately, like making decisions or following conversations?

Yes… that’s actually kind of why I came in. My head feels cloudy. I’ll look at a board packet or an email from a vendor, and I just… sit there. Simple decisions I used to make quickly feel harder now.
Would you say that most days you feel a noticeable loss of energy or feel fatigued, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I don’t really know. I mean, I get tired here and there, but I can’t say it’s most days or when I haven’t done much. I just haven’t paid close attention to that.
Would you say that your difficulty thinking clearly or concentrating has been present most days over the past two weeks?
Yes… I think so. It’s been happening a lot. I’ll sit with a board packet or an email from a vendor and just stare at it, like I can’t make even simple decisions the way I used to.
